text:
infra-bot: ALERT: apiserver p95 latency > 1200ms in eu-central1. etcd leader IO wait elevated, controller-manager leader re-elections starting, several GPU onboarding jobs returning 502s. Dashboard: https://grafana/reports/xyz

alex: seeing repeated errors in controller-manager logs: `E0821 09:12:34 leaderelection.go:324] failed to renew lease: operation not permitted` then `failed to tryAcquireOrRenew`

maria: also seeing a ton of list/watch traffic from prometheus + kube-state-metrics + custom autoscaler. Scrape interval spikes at 15s on some endpoints, hammering apiserver. Top clients by QPS: prometheus (k8s), autoscaler-service.

sam: proposed quick mitigation: bump prometheus scrape interval to 60s for kube-state-metrics and enable apiserver aggregated layer caching for read-only paths. I'll patch prometheus config and restart.

alex: NVMe IOPS on the etcd leader node is at 95% util, compaction happened during the spike causing synchronous fsync delays (~2s per write). If we keep this, leases will keep timing out. We should consider moving etcd leader or temporarily increasing disk iops.

jordan: we can move the leader to node-3 (eu-central1-a) which has lower io contention. I can run `ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl --endpoints=... move-leader <member-id>` if infra ok.

maria: +1 from me. Also temporary mitigation: disable the Dedicated GPU autoscaler to stop onboarding churn — attach/controller churn is producing attach/delete watch storms. Costs ok for a short window.

sam: patched prometheus scrape interval to 60s for kube-state-metrics and scaled down the aggressive job. Restarted prometheus-operator. `kubectl -n monitoring rollout status deploy/prometheus-operator` returned successful. Observability: apiserver p95 dropped 1200ms -> ~450ms within 90s. Still seeing occasional lease renew failures.

alex: initiating etcd move-leader now: `ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl --endpoints=https://10.0.1.2:2379 move-leader 4b1f2c` — will update when complete.

deploybot: deploy: prometheus config patch applied (prom-configmap) and rollout completed :white_check_mark:

alex: move-leader succeeded. etcd leader moved to node-3. IO wait dropped to <20%. controller-manager re-elections stopped, lease renewals stable. Monitoring for 15m window.

jordan: follow-ups we should track as tickets: 1) throttle autoscaler attach concurrency and add jitter on onboarding 2) move etcd leader disk class to gp3/io2 or reserved iops for leader-only members 3) review leader lease duration (current 20s) — maybe increase to 30s to reduce sensitivity, but note failover detection latency implications.

maria: I'll open PRs: autoscaler flags + prewarmed GPU pool fallback. Quick cost delta if we keep N prewarm nodes in eu-central1: approx +$2.4k/mo. PR link to follow.

alex: thanks team. Now set channel to watch-only. Reopen if we see re-elections or attach errors resume. :thumbsup:
